capabilities: Animate sidebar opening as a card transition where the note shrinks and slides aside
Track the swipe with the finger and finish on a spring after release
Trigger a light haptic tick when the card crosses the halfway point
Apply the animation to both the left and right sidebar
Fall back to default sidebar behaviour if an Obsidian update breaks it
disambiguation: Not a sidebar manager or a theme; it only changes how the existing mobile sidebars animate and works with any theme.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian mobile 1.11+ with sliding sidebars enabled; inactive on desktop, iPad and tablets. Tested with Minimal, Excalidraw, Kanban and Notebook Navigator; a known gesture overlap can occur if Notebook Navigator is moved to the right sidebar.
intentEvidence: Obsidian still decides when a swipe opens or closes a sidebar. Fluid Sidebar only changes how the movement looks
motivation: The author felt the default mobile sidebar transition was flat and mechanical, and wanted the note-to-sidebar movement to feel smooth and physical like native iOS apps.
problem: On phones, Obsidian's sidebar simply slides flatly over the note with no depth or feedback, making the frequent note-to-sidebar movement feel mechanical.
summary: Mobile-only plugin that replaces Obsidian's flat sidebar slide with a finger-following card animation that springs on release and gives haptic feedback.
